name: Informativeness
description: The degree to which the summary presents useful and relevant information from the original article.

name: Coherence
description: The degree to which the summary is well-organized, logically connected, and easy to follow.

name: Fluency
description: The degree to which the summary is grammatically correct, clear, and concise.

name: Relevance
description: The degree to which the summary accurately reflects the content and main points of the original article.

name: Creativity
description: The degree to which the summary presents a unique and original perspective on the content of the original article.
